[March 27th to 31st](https://help.neostella.com/hc/en-us/articles/38853128362903-march-2026-release-notes#h_01KW14M2731RN000000000001) 2. [March 23th to 27th](https://help.neostella.com/hc/en-us/articles/38853128362903-march-2026-release-notes#h_01KMRFC6A8BM8F25GQJZTPSKKW) 3. [March 10th to 16th](https://help.neostella.com/hc/en-us/articles/38853128362903-march-2026-release-notes#h_01KM6N8QAGPC38X5J9FJVWVH60) 4. [March 9th - March 13th](https://help.neostella.com/hc/en-us/articles/38853128362903-march-2026-release-notes#h_01KKKRF33P67BJJ4TVNS8E65QY) 5. [March 2nd - March 6th](https://help.neostella.com/hc/en-us/articles/38853128362903-march-2026-release-notes#h_01KKKRF33QV10AEQ4B4N3NQ1YJ) These release notes summarize the new features, latest updates, and bug fixes from this month in **Neostella** platform. For a complete list of product-specific changes, please visit our **Help Center** articles for detailed information. * * * ## March 27th to 31st ### adoption | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/39194630081175) | **Search Infrastructure Auto-Provisioning:**
All search components, including indexes, views, analyzers, and computed values, are now automatically created when a new tenant is provisioned, removing the need for manual setup. | * * * ### [process studio - automation](https://help.neostella.com/hc/en-us/categories/37505734654743-Neostella-Control-Center\#:~:text=schema%20%2D%20project%20feed-,process%20studio%20%2D%20automations,-process%20studio%20%2D%20automations) | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/39194630081175) | **External HTTP POST Action:**
A new action in the **Automation Builder** allows integrations with third-party systems by sending a POST request to a specified URL, including the Object ID and Context ID from the **Starting Rule**. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/39194630081175) | **Starting Rules for All RAW Events:**
**Starting Rules** now support all RAW events, allowing users to trigger automations on object creation, updates, and other custom events for both system and custom objects. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334760855) | **Deleted Status for Automations:**
A new **Deleted** status is now available in the **Automation Canvas** to better reflect the lifecycle of removed automations. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334760855) | **Loop Iterations in Execution Logs:**
Execution logs now display individual loop iterations, providing greater visibility into automation runs. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334760855) | **Edit Published and Unpublished Automations:**
Users can now edit both published and unpublished automations directly from the **Automation Canvas Editor**. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334760855) | **Starting Rule AQL Migration:**
Starting Rules have been migrated to use **AQL**, improving consistency and query performance. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334761623) | **Calculate Date Difference Result:**
Fixed **Calculate Date Difference** returning incorrect results when the start and end dates are equal. The expected result is now **0**. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334761623) | **Dynamic Variable Selection in Time Actions:**
Fixed date fields not allowing dynamic variable selection in **Time Actions**. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334761623) | **Context Object Record ID Dropdown:**
Fixed the **Context Object Record ID** dropdown showing empty or undefined records at the bottom of the options list in **Create** and **Update** actions. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334761623) | **Automation Version Auto-Save:**
Fixed an issue where adding a new automation version triggered an auto-save that incorrectly replaced an existing **Unpublished** version with a **Draft**. | * * * ### core | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/39194630081175) | **Lead Stage Management:**
Users can now manage and configure stages for **Leads** directly within the platform. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334761623) | **Zoom Integration Window:**
Fixed the **Zoom** integration window getting stuck in the medical tab and being unremovable. | * * * ### [documents](https://help.neostella.com/hc/en-us/sections/38853007815831-documents) | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/39194630081175) | **Edit Working Session Name:**
Users can now rename working sessions directly from the platform. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/39194630081175) | **Working Session List in Details Panel:**
The details panel now displays a list of working sessions associated with a document. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/39194630081175) | **Thumbnails in Tile View:**
Document thumbnails are now retrieved and displayed in the **Tile View** for a richer browsing experience. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/39194630081175) | **Thumbnails in Details Panels:**
Thumbnails are now applied and visible within document details panels. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/39194630081175) | **Folders in Document Grid:**
Folders can now be added to and managed within the **Document Grid**, improving document navigation and organization. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334761623) | **Working Session Name Update:**
Fixed the **Working Session** name failing to update due to an error in the **PUT /working sessions** endpoint. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334761623) | **Documents Grid Navigation:**
Fixed inconsistent navigation behavior in the **Documents** grid. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334761623) | **Document List in Project View:**
Fixed the **Document List** not displaying correctly in the **Project** view. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334761623) | **Upload Documents to Folders:**
Fixed an issue preventing users from uploading documents to folders. Previously, the platform showed a success message followed by a permission error and upload failure. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334761623) | **Word Add-in Variable Insertion:**
Fixed **Word Add-in** variable insertion failing with a 404 error on the **documents/template/upload** endpoint. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334761623) | **Drag-and-Drop Folder Behavior:**
Fixed unexpected behavior when dragging and dropping files into specific folders. | * * * ### [schema](https://help.neostella.com/hc/en-us/categories/37505734654743-Neostella-Control-Center\#:~:text=to%20manage%20translations-,schema,-schema%20overview%20%2D%20how) | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334760855) | **Object Builder Navigation, Search, and Visibility:**
The **Object Builder** has been enhanced with improved navigation, search capabilities, and field visibility controls. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334760855) | **Hidden and Archived Fields Restriction:**
Hidden or archived fields can no longer be inserted into display cards, details panels, or grids, helping preserve data integrity. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334761623) | **Date Values in Period and Date Fields:**
Fixed an error when saving date values in **Period** and **Date** fields in **Projects**. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334761623) | **Custom Object is system Value:**
Fixed new custom object fields being created with **is\_system: false** instead of the correct value. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334761623) | **Imported Objects Missing Mandatory Attributes:**
Fixed objects being imported without their mandatory attributes. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334761623) | **Numeric Field Icons:**
Fixed field icons missing after creating numeric fields. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334761623) | **Import Button Action:**
Fixed the **IMPORT** button not triggering any action when an issue is identified during object import. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334761623) | **Type Validations After Import:**
Fixed type validations not being enforced after importing an object. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334761623) | **PUT Fields is\_system Protection:**
Fixed the **PUT fields** endpoint allowing unauthorized changes to the **is\_system** attribute. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334761623) | **Dropdown Saved Default Values:**
Fixed dropdown saved default values not displaying in the frontend even though they were saved in the backend. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334761623) | **Empty Non-Required Dropdown Blocking Save:**
Fixed an empty, non-required dropdown field blocking users from saving a new project. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334761623) | **Dropdown and Multiple-Choice Values in Grid:**
Fixed dropdown and multiple-choice field values not displaying in the grid after saving. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334761623) | **Date Format in Forms:**
Fixed the wrong date format being displayed in **Date** fields within **Forms**. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334761623) | **Org Object Editing in Production:**
Fixed the inability to edit the **Org** object in **Production**. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334761623) | **System Field Limitations and Deletion:**
Fixed an issue allowing users to add limitations to and delete system fields in new custom objects. | * * * ## March 23th to 27th ### adoption | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/39194630081175) | **Data Mapping Workspace:**
A new data **Mapping** section is now available in the **Control Center** under the **Schema** menu. This workspace centralizes all transformation-related configurations, making data migration and alignment easier to manage. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/39194630081175) | **Legacy ID Traceability:**
This feature links legacy system IDs to Neostella records, allowing users to track, validate, and see exactly what data was migrated, its source, and how it relates within the platform, providing full migration traceability. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/39194630081175) | **Transformation Configuration Endpoints:**
Neostella now supports endpoints to store and reuse transformation configurations ensuring consistent and scalable data transformation across migrations. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/39194630081175) | **Guided Data Transformation Mapping:**
A guided mapping and transformation process helps align incoming client data with the Neostella schema, allowing users to map and transform data efficiently. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/39194630081175) | **Data Contract API:**
Data Contracts can now be exposed via API. This allows users to view source data structures directly in the transformation UI for better clarity during mapping. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/39194630081175) | **Adapter  for Schema Generation (Filevine Oriented):**
A standardized method to convert client data structures into Neostella platform schema was implemented, ensuring consistency regardless of the source system. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/39194630081175) | **Raw Schema Extraction & JSON Standardization:**
Automatically extracts client database structures and converts them into a standardized JSON format for easier processing and migration. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/39194630081175) | **Schema Import Endpoint:**
Implementation teams can now automatically generate the customer’s schema, using a dedicated endpoint. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/39194630081175) | **Partner Tenant Provisioning:**
A Neostella partner tenant is now automatically created and linked to new tenants, enabling streamlined support and operational collaboration. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/39194630081175) | **Predefined Custom Filevine Objects:**
Neostella tenants can automatically include common Filevine objects (such as Contacts, Projects, and Documents) as part of their schema setup. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/39194630081175) | **Filevine Schema Import via API:**
Neostella can now retrieve and recreate a client’s Filevine schema directly via API, reducing manual setup. | * * * ### communications | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334760855) | **Connection Status Notification:**
Users will now see a **Connecting** message when Neostella is re-establishing its connection to notification services, improving visibility during connection interruptions. | * * * ### core | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334760855) | **Keyboard-Driven Rule Builder:**
The **Rule Builder** has been upgraded with a faster, keyboard-first experience. Users can type directly, use auto-suggestions, and build rules more efficiently with less reliance on mouse clicks. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334760855) | **Automatic Group Deactivation on Partnership End:**
When a partnership ends, all partner-managed or owned groups are automatically deactivated. The platform preserves access for users with other valid roles, ensuring secure and controlled access. | * * * ### [schema](https://help.neostella.com/hc/en-us/categories/37505734654743-Neostella-Control-Center\#:~:text=to%20manage%20translations-,schema,-schema%20overview%20%2D%20how) | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/39194630081175) | **Lead-to-Project Type Mapping:**
Lead Types can now be linked to Project Types. When a lead is converted, the corresponding Project Type is automatically assigned based on the configured mapping. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/39194630081175) | **Hard Delete for Objects (YOLO Mode):**
Now is allowed the permanent deletion of custom objects without schema validation. This feature is controlled by a feature flag and should be used with caution. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334760855) | **Filtered Relationship Endpoints:**
Relationships can now be filtered based on the **allow for** attribute, enabling more precise control over how object relationships are retrieved and used. | * * * ### [documents](https://help.neostella.com/hc/en-us/sections/38853007815831-documents) | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334761623) | **Fact Index Filter Panel Removed:**
Removed the filter panel from the Fact Index view to reduce confusion and improve usability. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334760855) | **Folder Structure Editing:**
Users can now rename folders and reorganize their hierarchy directly within the folder tree. | * * * ### [control center-documents](https://help.neostella.com/hc/en-us/sections/38853007815831-documents) | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334760855) | **Templates Grid Standardization:**
The Templates grid in Control Center now matches the standard grid experience used across the platform for consistency. | * * * ### [process studio - workflows](https://help.neostella.com/hc/en-us/sections/38111282297111-process-studio-workflows) | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/39194630081175) | **Outcome Code Management:**
Users can now fully manage (create, edit, delete) workflow completion codes and snooze reasons directly within the platform. | * * * ## March 10th to 16th ### core | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334760855) | **Environment Kill Switch:**
Platform administrators can now enable or disable individual tenants or entire environments (such as **Production** or **Staging**) to mitigate critical issues or control system behavior during maintenance. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334760855) | **Bulk Tag Assignment:**
Tags can now be bulk assigned or removed from multiple permission sets and user groups directly from their respective grids. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334761623) | **Owner Profile Editing Restriction:**
Fixed issue preventing the Owner user from editing their own profile | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334761623) | **Tenant Subdomain Update Issue:**
Fixed URL subdomain not updating when switching tenants. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334761623) | **Invitation Logo Expiry:**
Fixed Neostella logo in invitation emails expiring after one hour. | * * * ### finance -Time tracking | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/39194630081175) | **Time Tracking:**
A complete **Time** tracking experience is now available, enabling users to log, manage, and report on time directly. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/39194630081175) | **Time Entries View and Management:**
Users can view a comprehensive table of all their **Time Entries** across projects, with full visibility into related details for tracking and management.
Time entries can now be modified or removed directly from the **Time Entries** view. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/39194630081175) | **Native Timer:**
Users can create time entries manually or use a native timer. 
A visual indicator shows when a timer is running, even if the view is closed. 
Only one timer can run at a time, and users are prompted to pause the current timer if a new one is started. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/39194630081175) | **Task & User Filters on Reports:** Task and user filters are now available in **Time Entry** reports within **Projects**, making it easier to locate and analyze time records. | * * * ### finance-invoicing | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/39194630081175) | **Rates Management:**
The new **Rates** tab in the **Invoicing** interface allows users to create, manage, and assign billing rates. Rates include key details like name, amount, currency, validity dates, and description, and can be edited or deleted. A centralized list provides visibility, and users can be assigned or removed via a transfer list, with all tenant users and their rate information shown in one place. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334760855) | **Activity codes:**
UI enhancements improve the experience of creating and managing activity codes, streamlining configuration and usability. | * * * ### [explore](https://help.neostella.com/hc/en-us/sections/38908927091351-explore) | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/39194630081175) | **AI Explore:**
Users can now search and explore data using natural language. **Neostella** automatically generates filter chips from queries, allowing users to refine results dynamically. 
**Reports** can also be generated directly from natural language input. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/39194630081175) | **AI Chat About Cases (Demo):**
An **AI assistant** allows users to ask questions about a specific case and receive responses grounded in accessible project data, according to user permissions. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334760855) | **Advanced Search & Reports:**
Improved performance for search and report execution.
Introduced context-aware filters, allowing users to build searches and reports using object relationships within specific contexts. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334761623) | **Inconsistent Search Results:**
Fixed **Advanced Search UI** not consistently displaying results. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334761623) | **Filter Type Misclassification:**
Fixed relationship filters being treated as standard filters without inbound/outbound indicators. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334761623) | **Relationship Depth Selection Issue:**
Fixed inability to select a field when adding a **Relationship** depth (All) filter. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334761623) | **Preview Feedback Mismatch:**
Fixed **Preview** showing a success message while displaying **No fields selected** despite fields being selected. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334761623) | **Report Name Duplication:**
Fixed execution name duplicating the saved report name. | * * * ### [process studio - automation](https://help.neostella.com/hc/en-us/categories/37505734654743-Neostella-Control-Center\#:~:text=schema%20%2D%20project%20feed-,process%20studio%20%2D%20automations,-process%20studio%20%2D%20automations) | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334760855) | **Built-in Date & Time Actions:**
The Automation Builder now includes native date and time actions to simplify workflow creation: Calculate Date Difference, Format Date to String, Get Age, Get Current Date Time, Update Date, Is Day Weekday. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334761623) | **Node Rename:**
Fixed published automations allowing nodes to be renamed or deleted. | * * * ### [schema](https://help.neostella.com/hc/en-us/categories/37505734654743-Neostella-Control-Center\#:~:text=to%20manage%20translations-,schema,-schema%20overview%20%2D%20how) | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334760855) | **Export Schema:**
Users can export objects including fields, field groups, and object types, into a JSON file for reuse, backup, or review. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334760855) | **Import Schema:**
Previously exported schemas can now be imported into the same or different tenants, enabling faster configuration and environment replication. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334760855) | **Document Attachment Field:**
Documents can now be attached and related directly within object fields. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334761623) | **Immutable Relationship Target:**
Fixed an issue where the target object of a relationship field could not be changed after creation. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334761623) | **Incorrect Label Rendering:**
Fixed an issue where the label in the relationship field header did not update to reflect the correct display text. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334761623) | **Document Field Errors:**
Errors occurring when uploading or saving documents in a single-relation document field were fixed. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334761623) | **Unexpected Sidebar Behavior:**
Fixed an unexpected sidebar behavior after selecting an object. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334761623) | **Missing Unsaved Changes Warning:**
Fixed missing unsaved-changes warning when editing the Display tab. | * * * ### Adoption-data migration & provisioning | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/39194630081175) | **Fast Data Ingestion Tool:**
A new ingestion tool enables rapid loading of large, pre-validated datasets, significantly improving migration speed. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/39194630081175) | **Configurable Provisioning Services:**
Provisioning services can now be dynamically enabled based on configuration, supporting flexible onboarding scenarios. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/39194630081175) | **Automated S3 Bucket & IAM Setup:**
Each new tenant automatically receives an S3 migration bucket and IAM user, eliminating manual setup and streamlining partner onboarding. | | **![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334761623)** | Fixed **Project** label being incorrectly removed by a mapping error. | * * * ### communications | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334760855) | **Improved Feature:**
Improved layout and visual clarity in message drawers within Documents and Tasks
Cleaner main menu with removal of the Messages mock entry now that the feature is fully available
Dates standardized using ISO 8601 across the platform for improved consistency and interoperability | * * * ## March 9th - March 13th ### core | | | | --- | --- | | ### [access](https://help.neostella.com/hc/en-us/sections/38862011180567-access) | | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334760855) | **Regular (non-system) integration users can now be linked directly to user groups:**
either from the **Groups** or from the integration user record within the **Groups** tab. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334760855) | **Regular integration users can be linked directly to permission sets:**
allowing administrators to control access and capabilities more precisely. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334760855) | **Groups Tab for Integration Users:**
A **Groups** tab is now available in the Integration **User** record, allowing administrators to assign or remove group memberships directly from the user interface. | * * * ### [documents](https://help.neostella.com/hc/en-us/sections/38853007815831-documents) | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334760855) | **Drag and Drop Documents Between Folders:**
Users can now move documents between folders using drag-and-drop, simplifying document organization. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334760855) | **Replace Document File with Version History Preservation:**
Users can replace a document’s file while retaining the previous file in the version history, ensuring traceability and document continuity. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334760855) | **Refresh Version History:**
A new refresh icon has been added to the **Version History** panel, allowing users to manually reload the list of document versions. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334760855) | **Automatic Support for New File Extensions:**
New document file extensions are now automatically added to the filter list, ensuring that users can immediately filter documents by newly supported file types. | * * * ### [control center-documents](https://help.neostella.com/hc/en-us/sections/37787085622295-documents) | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334760855) | **Template Management Panel Improvements:**
The **Template Management** view now includes an improved side panel filtering experience. This update aligns the filtering behavior with **Documents** in the **Cases** workspace. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334760855) | **Consistent Document Details Experience:**
The details panel experience in **Templates** now mirrors the behavior used when opening a document details panel in the **Cases** workspace, providing a more consistent user interface. | * * * ### [process studio - automation](https://help.neostella.com/hc/en-us/categories/37505734654743-Neostella-Control-Center\#:~:text=schema%20%2D%20project%20feed-,process%20studio%20%2D%20automations,-process%20studio%20%2D%20automations) | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334760855) | **Retrieve Custom Object Records:**
Workflows can now retrieve lists of custom object records, allowing automations to work with collections of structured data. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334760855) | **Retrieve a Specific Custom Object Record:**
Automations can now retrieve a single custom object record within the Project context, enabling workflows to operate on specific data entries. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334760855) | **Create Custom Object Records:**
Workflows can now create new records in custom objects within the Project context, allowing automations to automatically structure and store project data. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334760855) | **Update Custom Object Records:**
Automations can now update existing custom object records, ensuring project data remains accurate and synchronized. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/38854334761623) | **Dynamic Variable Handling in Custom Object Actions:**
